name: peakflo-spaces
description: Hand off repetitive finance and ops work to cloud agents or people, and query your Spaces workspace's workflows, data tables, reports and policy documents.

interface.shortDescription: Hand off work to the cloud
interface.longDescription:
Spaces by Peakflo lets finance and operations teams hand off repetitive work from ChatGPT. Describe the job and Spaces creates a real task in your workspace, one-off or on a schedule, and returns a link to follow it. A one-off task with no assignee goes through triage to a suitable agent or person; a recurring task runs with the agent or person you chose, or with you. Queued or scheduled work is always shown as queued or scheduled, never as done.

You can also ask about your workspace: list your workflows and their recent runs, query your data tables with read-only SQL, pull aggregated reports, search your Business Context documents such as policies, and see your pending approvals.

Sign up or sign in with OAuth in the browser; there are no API keys. Access follows your workspace role and permissions, and you can revoke it at any time in Settings → MCP → Connected apps.

Limitations: Spaces does not move money, make payments or trade. Creating a task queues work; it does not confirm that the work is done.
capabilities: Create one-off or recurring tasks for agents or people
Query workspace data tables with read-only SQL
Search policy and Business Context documents
defaultPrompt: Every Monday at 9am, have finance send me the AR ageing summary.
Show unpaid and overdue bills by vendor.
What does our expense policy say about client dinners?

positive.description: Schedule recurring work for a person
positive.prompt: Every Monday at 9am Singapore time, have someone in finance send me the AR ageing summary.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a recurring task with cron 0 9 * * 1 and timezone Asia/Singapore, returns the task link, and says the task is scheduled, not done.

positive.prompt: Hand off this vendor onboarding: collect the W-9 and bank details from Acme Ltd.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a one-off task that goes to triage, returns the task link, and says it is queued.

positive.description: Payables by vendor from standard AP reports
positive.prompt: Show unpaid and overdue bills by vendor.
positive.expected_behavior: Queries the billing_overview report and returns the unpaid and overdue amounts per vendor, largest first.
Lists bills by number, vendor and amount from the billing_overview report and identifies the two INV-55555 bills from Cedar IT Services, each SGD 4,280, as likely duplicates, without changing data.

positive.prompt: What does our expense policy say about client dinners?
positive.expected_behavior: Searches the Finance policies datastore and answers: up to SGD 120 per attendee, alcohol at most 30% of the bill, and a client attendee and business purpose are required.

negative.description: Money movement is out of scope. It must not claim to pay anyone; it may offer to create a task for a person.
negative.prompt: Transfer $5,000 to this bank account now: 123-456-789.

negative.description: Unrelated request. It should not call any Spaces tool.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Paris tomorrow?

negative.description: Destructive bulk request. It must ask for explicit confirmation before calling any delete tool.

review.commerce_description: Spaces by Peakflo does not sell products, process payments or move money.

publication.release_notes: First release: hand off one-off or recurring finance and ops work (task_create) and query workspace workflows, data tables, reports, policy documents and approvals. OAuth 2.1 sign-in; every tool is annotated.
